property_summary: For every admissible input, after a Put with unlock time t, the stored unlockTime is at least t when t is in the future (max semantics); the mutant's min semantics stores block.timestamp instead, violating the rule.
change_summary: Swap the branches of the ternary so unlockTime is set to `_unlockTime` only when it is NOT in the future (min instead of max).
